paragraphs: R. Yehudah the priest, colleague of R. Yehudah ben Bava: Eduyot 8:2. He belongs to the first group after the destruction. One may wonder whether he is Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai's son, as in Yuchasin's sequence of generations under Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai. This does not appear likely: since Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai was nasi, he should have been mentioned by his father's name. See Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai above: according to Tosafot he was not a priest. R. Akiva disagrees with him in Kol HaYad, where the passage names Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai’s son.
